name: @coord/worker
// coordinator: @coord/coordinator is a runtime import (worker.ts takes BLANKET_DECLARATION_REASON from it, so both askers word an in-process claim the same way) and the tests read handoffs back through it. It belongs in dependencies, not below: it pulls in no native ML, and the worker loads it on every run.
//: @coord/api-gateway is a test-only import (worker.test.ts builds an in-process gateway to run the protocol against). It is a devDependency and must stay one: as a runtime dependency it drags @coord/local-triage -> @huggingface/transformers -> onnxruntime-node, over 600 MB of native ML that a worker never loads, into anything that packages this worker for a desktop.
